meta.name: prospect-discovery-pipeline
meta.description: Use when a teammate wants a full discovery-to-outreach pipeline anchored on existing clients. Triggers include "find prospects like [client]", "build a target list like [domain]", "lookalike discovery for [client]", "discovery to outreach for [criteria]", "10 companies similar to [X] with a CMO", or any multi-step request combining lookalike search + decision-maker identification + signal enrichment + LinkedIn variant drafting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从现有客户中挖掘相似潜客并生成外联方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需从老客户中找相似公司并快速发起外联
copy.tagline_en: Find lookalike prospects from existing clients and generate outreach drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find similar companies from existing clients and quickly start outreach

howto.what: 输入已有客户后，Claude 会自动完成5步流程：找相似公司→按条件筛选→找营销决策人→丰富公司信息→起草2版LinkedIn消息，每次扣费前会暂停让你确认。
howto.when: 当你提出“找和[客户]相似的潜在客户”“把[领域]做成目标列表”“从发现到联系[标准]”等涉及多步搜索+决策者识别+消息撰写的要求时触发。

say.text: 找10家像Shopify的公司，要他们的CMO。
say.note: 启动2个锚点的完整发现流程。

say.text: 把这几家SaaS客户做成线索列表，包含高管信息。
say.note: 触发ICP筛选和联系人查找。

howto.what_en: Given existing clients, Claude runs a 5-phase pipeline: lookalike search, ICP filter, CMO finder, multi-signal enrichment, and drafts 2 LinkedIn variants, pausing for approval before each credit-costly step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a multi-step discovery-to-outreach pipeline, e.g., 'find prospects like [client]', 'build target list like [domain]', or 'discovery to outreach for [criteria]'.

say_en.text: Find 10 companies similar to Shopify, with their CMOs.
Turn these SaaS clients into a lead list with exec contacts.
say_en.note: Triggers ICP filtering and contact lookup.
